# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). ERROR since crap4dart >=0.14.2 fixed the upstream
  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: terminal text is blocky mono
      # glyphs that read as solid Ahem rectangles (5 theme screenshots,
      # crap4dart 0.14.2), and omp_ref/03_tool_call.png genuinely
      # contains a yellow/black pattern. Not golden images — excluded,
      # not a detector bug to chase.
      - 'test/integration/**'

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1637

- **Title**: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)
- **Author**: IstiN
- **Branch**: `crap4dart-0142-broken-goldens` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +64
- **Deletions**: -39
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T20:12:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T20:27:37Z

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow
GREEN = (76, 175, 80)  # Material green — Habit Tracker tile
YELLOW = (255, 193, 7)  # amber timer digits (r>200, g>180, b<90)
DARK = (30, 30, 30)  # dark card — classifies as stripe-black


def canvas(size: int = 64, color: tuple[int, int, int] = WHITE):
    return [[color] * size for _ in range(size)]


def rect(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color):  # inclusive corners
    for y in range(y0, y1 + 1):
        for x in range(x0, x1 + 1):
            px[y][x] = color


def line(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color, thick=2):
    """Axis-ish thick line via Bresenham + square brush."""
    dx, dy = abs(x1 - x0), abs(y1 - y0)
    sx = 1 if x1 >= x0 else -1
    sy = 1 if y1 >= y0 else -1
    err = dx - dy
    x, y = x0, y0
    while True:
        for ox in range(thick):
            for oy in range(thick):
                px[min(y + oy, len(px) - 1)][min(x + ox, len(px[0]) - 1)] = color
        if x == x1 and y == y1:
            return
        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:
            err -= dy
            x += sx
        if e2 < dx:
            err += dx
            y += sy


# ── The six fixture classes ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each entry: filename -> (painter, today's measured verdict class,
# target verdict class after the upstream detector fixes).
#   "detect"  = the gate must flag it ("stripes" / "tofu")
#   "clean"   = the gate must pass it
# today="clean", target="detect"  → blind spot
# today="detect", target="clean"  → false positive

def _ahem_text(px):
    """A word of solid Ahem glyph rectangles: three 12x14 blocks, gap 3."""
    for i in range(3):
        rect(px, 8 + i * 15, 20, 19 + i * 15, 33, INK)


def _hollow_square(px):
    """Unloaded-icon placeholder: 24x24 box, 2px walls, NO diagonal."""
    rect(px, 20, 20, 43, 21, INK)
    rect(px, 20, 42, 43, 43, INK)
    rect(px, 20, 20, 21, 43, INK)
    rect(px, 42, 20, 43, 43, INK)


def _x_tofu(px):
    """True tofu: the same box plus a corner-to-corner X."""
    _hollow_square(px)
    line(px, 21, 21, 42, 42, INK)
    line(px, 42, 21, 21, 42, INK)


def _checkmark_tile(px):
    """Habit Tracker tile: rounded green square + white V — the FP that
    reads as an X signature (light theme, 5 goldens at 22px real size;
    drawn 28px here so the top-border run clears the detector's 20px
    minimum icon size)."""
    t0, t1 = 18, 45  # 28x28 tile
    cut = 3
    rect(px, t0, t0, t1, t1, GREEN)
    for c in range(cut):  # approximate rounded corners
        span = cut - c
        for d in range(span):
            px[t0 + c][t0 + d] = WHITE
            px[t0 + c][t1 - d] = WHITE
            px[t1 - c][t0 + d] = WHITE
            px[t1 - c][t1 - d] = WHITE
    # white checkmark V: short arm down-right, long arm up-right
    line(px, t0 + 8, t0 + 15, t0 + 13, t0 + 20, WHITE, thick=2)
    line(px, t0 + 13, t0 + 20, t0 + 21, t0 + 8, WHITE, thick=2)


def _overflow_stripes(px):
    """Flutter's overflow pattern: strict 45-degree yellow/black
    checkerboard — any row crosses it with real alternation."""
    size = len(px)
    for y in range(size):
        for x in range(size):
            px[y][x] = YELLOW if ((x + y) // 8) % 2 == 0 else INK


def _yellow_on_dark(px):
    """Amber digits on a dark card: 5 thick yellow bars with dark gaps —
    along their center row this alternates like stripes do (the
    panel_dark "25:00" false positive)."""
    rect(px, 0, 0, 63, 63, DARK)
    for i in range(5):
        x0 = 8 + i * 11
        rect(px, x0, 22, x0 + 3, 41, YELLOW)


FIXTURES = {
    # blind spot: broken golden, detector sees nothing (yet)
    "ahem_solid_text_rects.png": (_ahem_text, "clean", "detect"),
    "hollow_icon_square_no_x.png": (_hollow_square, "clean", "detect"),
    # false positive: clean golden, detector cries wolf (yet)
    "checkmark_tile_light.png": (_checkmark_tile, "detect", "clean"),
    "yellow_digits_on_dark.png": (_yellow_on_dark, "detect", "clean"),
    # regression guards: must stay detected before AND after the fixes
    "x_boxed_icon_tofu.png": (_x_tofu, "detect", "detect"),
    "overflow_stripes.png": (_overflow_stripes, "detect", "detect"),
}


# ── Fixture sanity (the --self-test ladder) ──────────────────────────────

def _stripe_kind(r, g, b):
    """Mirror of the gate's own classification (broken_goldens_gate)."""
    if r > 200 and g > 180 and b < 90:
        return "yellow"
    if r < 60 and g < 60 and b < 60:

    return "none"


def _stripes_elsewhere(name, px):
    """True when the image contains a row run the stripe heuristic eats:
    >= 8 px, >= 4 transitions, yellow >= 1/3 (gate thresholds)."""
    if "overflow_stripes" not in name and "yellow_digits" not in name:

# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it

  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}

  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known

    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.

  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid

  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the

  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.

    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # if any appear"). ERROR since crap4dart >=0.14.2 fixed the upstream
  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error

      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi

fi

STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only || true)

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow
GREEN = (76, 175, 80)  # Material green — Habit Tracker tile
YELLOW = (255, 193, 7)  # amber timer digits (r>200, g>180, b<90)
DARK = (30, 30, 30)  # dark card — classifies as stripe-black


def canvas(size: int = 64, color: tuple[int, int, int] = WHITE):
    return [[color] * size for _ in range(size)]


def rect(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color):  # inclusive corners
    for y in range(y0, y1 + 1):
        for x in range(x0, x1 + 1):
            px[y][x] = color


def line(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color, thick=2):
    """Axis-ish thick line via Bresenham + square brush."""
    dx, dy = abs(x1 - x0), abs(y1 - y0)
    sx = 1 if x1 >= x0 else -1
    sy = 1 if y1 >= y0 else -1
    err = dx - dy
    x, y = x0, y0
    while True:
        for ox in range(thick):
            for oy in range(thick):
                px[min(y + oy, len(px) - 1)][min(x + ox, len(px[0]) - 1)] = color
        if x == x1 and y == y1:
            return
        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:
            err -= dy
            x += sx
        if e2 < dx:
            err += dx
            y += sy


# ── The six fixture classes ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each entry: filename -> (painter, today's measured verdict class,
# target verdict class after the upstream detector fixes).
#   "detect"  = the gate must flag it ("stripes" / "tofu")
#   "clean"   = the gate must pass it
# today="clean", target="detect"  → blind spot
# today="detect", target="clean"  → false positive

def _ahem_text(px):
    """A word of solid Ahem glyph rectangles: three 12x14 blocks, gap 3."""
    for i in range(3):
        rect(px, 8 + i * 15, 20, 19 + i * 15, 33, INK)


def _hollow_square(px):
    """Unloaded-icon placeholder: 24x24 box, 2px walls, NO diagonal."""
    rect(px, 20, 20, 43, 21, INK)
    rect(px, 20, 42, 43, 43, INK)

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). ERROR since crap4dart >=0.14.2 fixed the upstream
  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: terminal text is blocky mono
      # glyphs that read as solid Ahem rectangles (5 theme screenshots,
      # crap4dart 0.14.2), and omp_ref/03_tool_call.png genuinely
      # contains a yellow/black pattern. Not golden images — excluded,
      # not a detector bug to chase.
      - 'test/integration/**'

  # dart-json/junit reporting the gate consumes. A PR validation's PTY legs

    # concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB — the rate-limit rationale is
    # documented on the llm tag in dart_test.yaml).

    # a single shard's ratchet would see partial lib/src/cli coverage
    # and false-regress. Each shard also emits the dart json
    # file-reporter: junit feeds rebalancing/budget-tightening PRs, the
    # raw json feeds the #928 duration gate (pty-coverage-gate below).
    # gh-1300: needs the once-per-run AOT build; FA_BIN points every CLI
    # spawn (PTY harness + headless helpers) at the prebuilt binary.

    # old mac leg had (the coverage-free linux twin never paid it) and arm64
    # Graviton cores run somewhat slower than the M-series minis did — margin
    # without stretching the watchdog much.
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff

blocks.text:
# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — loc scope (test/example)" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      ;;
    "")
      ;; # not activated — skip silently (CI and the fast gate cover it)
    *)
      echo "⚠️  crap4dart $C4D_VER is too old for the gates (need >= 0.11.0);" \
           "skipping — run: dart pub global activate crap4dart '>=0.11.0 <0.12.0'" >&2
      ;;
  esac
fi

# Golden-coverage quick check — only when the staged diff can affect the
# flutter_app (the gate's own markers already told us the flutter stage
# ran or was skipped; recompute cheaply from the staged paths here).
STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only || true)
if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '^(flutter_app/|packages/|lib/|scripts/|\.github/|pubspec\.)' \
   || ! echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '\.(md)$|^docs/|^prompts/'; then
  if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "🔍 Checking golden coverage..."
    if python3 scripts/check_goldens.py --quick; then
      echo "✅ Golden gate OK"
    else
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
fi

# Issue #433 AC1 (cheap, config-only): README CRAP badge must equal the
# crap4dart.yaml thresholds — runs only when a config or the README is
# staged, i.e. exactly the files that can drift apart.
if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '(^|/)crap4dart\.yaml$|^README\.md$'; then
  python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py
fi

echo ""
echo "╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  ✅ ALL QUALITY GATES PASSED — COMMIT APPROVED                            ║"

- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T20:27:37Z

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow
GREEN = (76, 175, 80)  # Material green — Habit Tracker tile
YELLOW = (255, 193, 7)  # amber timer digits (r>200, g>180, b<90)
DARK = (30, 30, 30)  # dark card — classifies as stripe-black


def canvas(size: int = 64, color: tuple[int, int, int] = WHITE):
    return [[color] * size for _ in range(size)]


def rect(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color):  # inclusive corners
    for y in range(y0, y1 + 1):
        for x in range(x0, x1 + 1):
            px[y][x] = color


def line(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color, thick=2):
    """Axis-ish thick line via Bresenham + square brush."""
    dx, dy = abs(x1 - x0), abs(y1 - y0)
    sx = 1 if x1 >= x0 else -1
    sy = 1 if y1 >= y0 else -1
    err = dx - dy
    x, y = x0, y0
    while True:
        for ox in range(thick):
            for oy in range(thick):
                px[min(y + oy, len(px) - 1)][min(x + ox, len(px[0]) - 1)] = color
        if x == x1 and y == y1:
            return
        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:
            err -= dy
            x += sx
        if e2 < dx:
            err += dx
            y += sy


# ── The six fixture classes ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each entry: filename -> (painter, today's measured verdict class,
# target verdict class after the upstream detector fixes).
#   "detect"  = the gate must flag it ("stripes" / "tofu")
#   "clean"   = the gate must pass it
# today="clean", target="detect"  → blind spot
# today="detect", target="clean"  → false positive

def _ahem_text(px):
    """A word of solid Ahem glyph rectangles: three 12x14 blocks, gap 3."""
    for i in range(3):
        rect(px, 8 + i * 15, 20, 19 + i * 15, 33, INK)


def _hollow_square(px):
    """Unloaded-icon placeholder: 24x24 box, 2px walls, NO diagonal."""
    rect(px, 20, 20, 43, 21, INK)
    rect(px, 20, 42, 43, 43, INK)
    rect(px, 20, 20, 21, 43, INK)
    rect(px, 42, 20, 43, 43, INK)


def _x_tofu(px):
    """True tofu: the same box plus a corner-to-corner X."""
    _hollow_square(px)
    line(px, 21, 21, 42, 42, INK)
    line(px, 42, 21, 21, 42, INK)


def _checkmark_tile(px):
    """Habit Tracker tile: rounded green square + white V — the FP that
    reads as an X signature (light theme, 5 goldens at 22px real size;
    drawn 28px here so the top-border run clears the detector's 20px
    minimum icon size)."""
    t0, t1 = 18, 45  # 28x28 tile
    cut = 3
    rect(px, t0, t0, t1, t1, GREEN)
    for c in range(cut):  # approximate rounded corners
        span = cut - c
        for d in range(span):
            px[t0 + c][t0 + d] = WHITE
            px[t0 + c][t1 - d] = WHITE
            px[t1 - c][t0 + d] = WHITE
            px[t1 - c][t1 - d] = WHITE
    # white checkmark V: short arm down-right, long arm up-right
    line(px, t0 + 8, t0 + 15, t0 + 13, t0 + 20, WHITE, thick=2)
    line(px, t0 + 13, t0 + 20, t0 + 21, t0 + 8, WHITE, thick=2)


def _overflow_stripes(px):
    """Flutter's overflow pattern: strict 45-degree yellow/black
    checkerboard — any row crosses it with real alternation."""
    size = len(px)
    for y in range(size):
        for x in range(size):
            px[y][x] = YELLOW if ((x + y) // 8) % 2 == 0 else INK


def _yellow_on_dark(px):
    """Amber digits on a dark card: 5 thick yellow bars with dark gaps —
    along their center row this alternates like stripes do (the
    panel_dark "25:00" false positive)."""
    rect(px, 0, 0, 63, 63, DARK)
    for i in range(5):
        x0 = 8 + i * 11
        rect(px, x0, 22, x0 + 3, 41, YELLOW)


FIXTURES = {
    # blind spot: broken golden, detector sees nothing (yet)
    "ahem_solid_text_rects.png": (_ahem_text, "clean", "detect"),
    "hollow_icon_square_no_x.png": (_hollow_square, "clean", "detect"),
    # false positive: clean golden, detector cries wolf (yet)
    "checkmark_tile_light.png": (_checkmark_tile, "detect", "clean"),
    "yellow_digits_on_dark.png": (_yellow_on_dark, "detect", "clean"),
    # regression guards: must stay detected before AND after the fixes
    "x_boxed_icon_tofu.png": (_x_tofu, "detect", "detect"),
    "overflow_stripes.png": (_overflow_stripes, "detect", "detect"),
}


# ── Fixture sanity (the --self-test ladder) ──────────────────────────────

def _stripe_kind(r, g, b):
    """Mirror of the gate's own classification (broken_goldens_gate)."""
    if r > 200 and g > 180 and b < 90:
        return "yellow"
    if r < 60 and g < 60 and b < 60:
        return "black"
    return "none"


def _stripes_elsewhere(name, px):
    """True when the image contains a row run the stripe heuristic eats:
    >= 8 px, >= 4 transitions, yellow >= 1/3 (gate thresholds)."""
    if "overflow_stripes" not in name and "yellow_digits" not in name:
        return False
    for row in px:
        run = transitions = yellows = 0
        last = None
        for r, g, b in row:
            kind = _stripe_kind(r, g, b)
            if kind == "none":
                run = transitions = yellows = 0
                last = None
                continue
            if kind != last:
                transitions += 1
                last = kind

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1637
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1637
- **Title**: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)
- **Author**: IstiN
- **Branch**: `crap4dart-0142-broken-goldens` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +64
- **Deletions**: -39
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T20:12:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T20:27:37Z

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (

        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)

def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px

    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))

def line(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color, thick=2):
    """Axis-ish thick line via Bresenham + square brush."""
    dx, dy = abs(x1 - x0), abs(y1 - y0)
    sx = 1 if x1 >= x0 else -1
    sy = 1 if y1 >= y0 else -1
    err = dx - dy
    x, y = x0, y0

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.

  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);

    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). ERROR since crap4dart >=0.14.2 fixed the upstream
  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:

      # glyphs that read as solid Ahem rectangles (5 theme screenshots,
      # crap4dart 0.14.2), and omp_ref/03_tool_call.png genuinely
      # contains a yellow/black pattern. Not golden images — excluded,
      # not a detector bug to chase.
      - 'test/integration/**'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow
GREEN = (76, 175, 80)  # Material green — Habit Tracker tile
YELLOW = (255, 193, 7)  # amber timer digits (r>200, g>180, b<90)
DARK = (30, 30, 30)  # dark card — classifies as stripe-black


def canvas(size: int = 64, color: tuple[int, int, int] = WHITE):
    return [[color] * size for _ in range(size)]


def rect(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color):  # inclusive corners
    for y in range(y0, y1 + 1):
        for x in range(x0, x1 + 1):
            px[y][x] = color


def line(px, x0, y0, x1, y1, color, thick=2):
    """Axis-ish thick line via Bresenham + square brush."""
    dx, dy = abs(x1 - x0), abs(y1 - y0)
    sx = 1 if x1 >= x0 else -1
    sy = 1 if y1 >= y0 else -1
    err = dx - dy
    x, y = x0, y0
    while True:
        for ox in range(thick):
            for oy in range(thick):
                px[min(y + oy, len(px) - 1)][min(x + ox, len(px[0]) - 1)] = color
        if x == x1 and y == y1:
            return
        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:
            err -= dy
            x += sx
        if e2 < dx:
            err += dx
            y += sy


# ── The six fixture classes ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each entry: filename -> (painter, today's measured verdict class,
# target verdict class after the upstream detector fixes).
#   "detect"  = the gate must flag it ("stripes" / "tofu")
#   "clean"   = the gate must pass it
# today="clean", target="detect"  → blind spot
# today="detect", target="clean"  → false positive

def _ahem_text(px):
    """A word of solid Ahem glyph rectangles: three 12x14 blocks, gap 3."""
    for i in range(3):
        rect(px, 8 + i * 15, 20, 19 + i * 15, 33, INK)


def _hollow_square(px):
    """Unloaded-icon placeholder: 24x24 box, 2px walls, NO diagonal."""
    rect(px, 20, 20, 43, 21, INK)
    rect(px, 20, 42, 43, 43, INK)
    rect(px, 20, 20, 21, 43, INK)
    rect(px, 42, 20, 43, 43, INK)


def _x_tofu(px):
    """True tofu: the same box plus a corner-to-corner X."""
    _hollow_square(px)
    line(px, 21, 21, 42, 42, INK)
    line(px, 42, 21, 21, 42, INK)


def _checkmark_tile(px):
    """Habit Tracker tile: rounded green square + white V — the FP that
    reads as an X signature (light theme, 5 goldens at 22px real size;
    drawn 28px here so the top-border run clears the detector's 20px
    minimum icon size)."""
    t0, t1 = 18, 45  # 28x28 tile
    cut = 3
    rect(px, t0, t0, t1, t1, GREEN)
    for c in range(cut):  # approximate rounded corners
        span = cut - c
        for d in range(span):
            px[t0 + c][t0 + d] = WHITE
            px[t0 + c][t1 - d] = WHITE
            px[t1 - c][t0 + d] = WHITE
            px[t1 - c][t1 - d] = WHITE
    # white checkmark V: short arm down-right, long arm up-right
    line(px, t0 + 8, t0 + 15, t0 + 13, t0 + 20, WHITE, thick=2)
    line(px, t0 + 13, t0 + 20, t0 + 21, t0 + 8, WHITE, thick=2)


def _overflow_stripes(px):
    """Flutter's overflow pattern: strict 45-degree yellow/black
    checkerboard — any row crosses it with real alternation."""
    size = len(px)
    for y in range(size):
        for x in range(size):
            px[y][x] = YELLOW if ((x + y) // 8) % 2 == 0 else INK


def _yellow_on_dark(px):
    """Amber digits on a dark card: 5 thick yellow bars with dark gaps —
    along their center row this alternates like stripes do (the
    panel_dark "25:00" false positive)."""
    rect(px, 0, 0, 63, 63, DARK)
    for i in range(5):
        x0 = 8 + i * 11
        rect(px, x0, 22, x0 + 3, 41, YELLOW)


FIXTURES = {
    # blind spot: broken golden, detector sees nothing (yet)
    "ahem_solid_text_rects.png": (_ahem_text, "clean", "detect"),
    "hollow_icon_square_no_x.png": (_hollow_square, "clean", "detect"),
    # false positive: clean golden, detector cries wolf (yet)
    "checkmark_tile_light.png": (_checkmark_tile, "detect", "clean"),
    "yellow_digits_on_dark.png": (_yellow_on_dark, "detect", "clean"),
    # regression guards: must stay detected before AND after the fixes
    "x_boxed_icon_tofu.png": (_x_tofu, "detect", "detect"),
    "overflow_stripes.png": (_overflow_stripes, "detect", "detect"),
}


# ── Fixture sanity (the --self-test ladder) ──────────────────────────────

def _stripe_kind(r, g, b):
    """Mirror of the gate's own classification (broken_goldens_gate)."""
    if r > 200 and g > 180 and b < 90:
        return "yellow"
    if r < 60 and g < 60 and b < 60:
        return "black"
    return "none"


def _stripes_elsewhere(name, px):
    """True when the image contains a row run the stripe heuristic eats:
    >= 8 px, >= 4 transitions, yellow >= 1/3 (gate thresholds)."""
    if "overflow_stripes" not in name and "yellow_digits" not in name:
        return False
    for row in px:
        run = transitions = yellows = 0
        last = None
        for r, g, b in row:
            kind = _stripe_kind(r, g, b)
            if kind == "none":
                run = transitions = yellows = 0
                last = None
                continue
            if kind != last:

                last = kind

    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted

  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}

  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}
